headline: China Moves to Confiscate 61,800 Bitcoin Tied to $5.7B Fraud Case
summary: Chinese prosecutors have initiated steps to confiscate over 61,800 Bitcoin connected to an alleged $5.7 billion fraud scheme, following a UK court ruling that Chinese law governs restitution claims.
why: Large state-directed crypto seizures and prospective asset disposals can impact global market liquidity and regulatory frameworks for cross-border asset recovery.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: State claims over 61,800 BTC create potential supply overhang risks depending on eventual liquidation proceedings.
